=SELECT t.*, b.booking_id, b.guest_name, b.guest_phone, b.property_id,
  b.property_name, b.check_in_date, b.check_out_date, b.total_amount,
  b.booking_status, b.payment_status
FROM payment_action_tokens t
JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id = t.booking_id
WHERE t.token = '{{ $json.token }}'
  AND t.action = '{{ $json.action }}'

=UPDATE bookings
SET booking_status = 'confirmed',
    payment_status = 'paid',
    notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || 'Payment confirmed via link at ' || CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::text || '. ',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE booking_id = '{{ $json.booking_id }}'
RETURNING *

=UPDATE bookings
SET booking_status = 'cancelled',
    payment_status = 'cancelled',
    notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || 'Cancelled via link at ' || CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::text || '. ',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE booking_id = '{{ $json.booking_id }}'
RETURNING *

=UPDATE payment_action_tokens
SET used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE token = '{{ $('Check Valid').item.json.token_uuid }}'
